summary: LSB Industries filed an 8-K reporting it will assume full ownership of a carbon capture and sequestration project at its El Dorado, Arkansas facility from Lapis Carbon Solutions. Total consideration and remaining completion capital are estimated at approximately $95 million, with portions contingent on timely achievement of defined milestones and completion activities. The effective date is May 18, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, deal structure, or regulatory timeline is disclosed. This is not a standard special-situation transaction; watch for project completion milestones and cost overruns as key risk factors.
